title: Signal: Possible a Mollie API key in source
scope: Single-line shape match for a Mollie API key.
limitations: Shape-only over a generic live_/test_ prefix: documentation and test fixtures of other providers can look identical. The denylist and the boundary guard reduce, but do not remove, that false-positive class.
fpNotes: Documentation and redacted examples using the same prefix are the common false positives.
